object.description: With the MCP server on a repository of PARENT and CHILD, leave conflict markers in CHILD's only object file, starting on line 3. Call list_documents, validate_repo and repo_health, then validate_repo and repo_health again with the repository root given as a path through CHILD/... Expected: list_documents returns CHILD with exactly doc_id, folder and load_error, and no counts; the load error holds exactly doc_id CHILD, file CHILD/objects/CHILD-0.xml, line 3 and a message ending '(unresolved merge conflict?)'. PARENT is listed without a load error. validate_repo isn't ok, reports PARENT's results and CHILD's load error; repo_health reports the same load error; each file is given relative to the repository root.
